text: I had a problem with my eye suddenly got inflamed and the vision was pretty much affected. The doctor arrived very soon after my call to the medical insurance and conducted a thorough examination. The prescribed medication was appropriate and the advised further investigation by the specialist was completely justified. Soon after the treatment my eye become functional again. The communication with Medical Vranes by WhatsApp was perfect. Highly recommend for anyone.
